newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritian Happy World Foods profit below forecast.
newsitem.headline: Mauritian Happy World Foods profit below forecast.

text.p: Mauritian food concern Happy World Foods Limited on Wednesday reported a pre-tax profit of 62.5 million rupees ($3 million) for the financial year ending 30 June 1996, lower than previous forecasts.
The company said in a statement that profit was lower than the 63.8 million rupees it forecast in early 1996.
Happy World Foods turnover for the year was 4.0 percent above a forecast of 873.9 million rupees and after tax profits 6.0 percent better than expected at 59.3 million rupees.
The company forecast a 15 percent growth in turnover in the financial year 1996/97.

"Despite the current economic situation which appears to be difficult, the company is confident that it has the necessary management resources and trading skills to achieve a growth in turnover of around 15 percent which will result in increased pre-tax profit," one company official said.
Happy World Foods, formerly known as Mauritius Farms Ltd, was formed in December 1994 when Mauritius Farm acquired the cold store division of its parent company Happy World Ltd.
Happy World Foods reported a pre-tax profit of 27.9 million rupees for the seven months period to 30 June 1995, turnover of 425.4 million rupees and profit after tax of 23.8 million rupees.
Happy World Foods' activity extend from poultry and ice cream production to import and distribution of consumer goods in the Mauritian local market.
Happy World Foods was listed on the Stock Exchange of Mauritius on February 28, 1996.
